tools.name: new_project
tools.description: Start a fresh schematic world and/or mesh. Call this before building something new.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: World + mesh stats: block count, bounds, Bloxd chunk count (160 max per file), selection, mesh parts.

tools.name: lookup_block
tools.description: Search the official 2,090 Bloxd block names/IDs. Pass a name fragment, numeric id, or #RRGGBB color.

tools.name: nearest_block
tools.description: Find the closest official Bloxd block to an RGB color.

tools.name: set_block
tools.description: Place or paint a single block. id 0 / Air removes it.

tools.name: set_blocks
tools.description: Place many blocks at once. Each entry is [x, y, z, blockNameOrId]. Faster than set_block for details.

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: Read the block at x,y,z.

tools.name: fill_box
tools.description: Fill an axis-aligned box from corner a to corner b. hollow=true builds only the shell (walls/floor/ceiling).

tools.name: fill_sphere
tools.description: Solid or hollow sphere centered at x,y,z.

tools.name: fill_ellipsoid
tools.description: Ellipsoid (stretched sphere) with independent radii.

tools.name: fill_cylinder
tools.description: Cylinder. axis is y (upright, default), x, or z.

tools.name: draw_line
tools.description: Voxel line from a to b. Optional radius makes a thick tube.

tools.name: draw_ring
tools.description: Horizontal (default) or vertical ring / torus slice.

tools.name: draw_cone
tools.description: Point-up cone sitting on y.

tools.name: draw_pyramid
tools.description: Stepped pyramid. size is the base half-width in blocks.

tools.name: flood_fill
tools.description: Recolor a connected blob of the same block id, 6-neighbour.

tools.name: replace_blocks
tools.description: Replace every from-block with to-block, optionally inside a box region.

tools.name: remove_region
tools.description: Delete every block inside the box a→b.

tools.name: select_box
tools.description: Select every occupied block inside a→b. Later rotate/mirror/hollow/dilate/erode/extrude use this selection.

tools.name: select_connected
tools.description: Select the connected same-type blob at x,y,z.

tools.name: copy_selection
tools.description: Copy the current selection to the clipboard (keeps original).

tools.name: cut_selection
tools.description: Cut the current selection to the clipboard.

tools.name: paste
tools.description: Paste the clipboard with its lowest corner at x,y,z.

tools.name: delete_selection
tools.description: Delete selected blocks without copying.

tools.name: move_selection
tools.description: Nudge the selection by dx,dy,dz blocks.

tools.name: rotate_selection
tools.description: Rotate the selection 90° around x, y (default) or z.

tools.name: mirror_selection
tools.description: Mirror the selection across x, y or z.

tools.name: hollow_selection
tools.description: Delete interior blocks of the selection, keeping a 1-block shell.

tools.name: dilate_selection
tools.description: Grow the selection by 1 block (von Neumann).

tools.name: erode_selection
tools.description: Shrink the selection by 1 block.

tools.name: smooth_selection
tools.description: Majority-smooth block ids on the selection.

tools.name: extrude_selection
tools.description: Extrude the selection along dx,dy,dz (default +Y by 1).

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last world edit.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone world edit.

tools.name: terrain_brush
tools.description: VoxelForge terrain/biome brush. tool: raise, lower, flatten, smooth, erode, terrace, river, road, cliff, beach, biome, vegetation, snow.

tools.name: generate_structure
tools.description: Native Bloxd procedural generator. type: terrain, island, canyon, tunnel, city, tower, castle, coral, crystals, rocks, maze, pipes, fractal, station.

tools.name: apply_texture
tools.description: Paint a weighted block palette with noise (fractal Perlin, checker, stripes, ...).

tools.name: export_schematic
tools.description: Encode the world as .bloxdschem. If it needs more than 160 Bloxd chunks it is split into named parts (name_part001_x0_z64.bloxdschem) plus a ZIP, manifest and placement guide. Never refuses a build for size.

tools.name: import_schematic
tools.description: Import a .bloxdschem given as base64. Offsets in the filename (_x _z _y) are honoured.

tools.name: mesh_add
tools.description: Add a decorative mesh part. type BloxdBlock (official block texture) or Box (solid RGB colour). Coordinates are in blocks, origin at the model feet. Size can be fractional.

tools.name: mesh_update
tools.description: Move, resize, recolor or swap the block of a mesh part.

tools.name: mesh_remove
tools.description: Delete a mesh part by id.

tools.name: mesh_duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate a mesh part, offset in blocks.

tools.name: mesh_list
tools.description: List every mesh part with ids, transforms and materials.

tools.name: export_mesh_code
tools.description: Export the mesh as JavaScript to paste into Bloxd World Code (default) or a Code Block. Meshes are decorative entities, not terrain.
